name: run_ledger_partial_fill_cancel
description: An intended 10-contract order is partially filled for 4 and the rest is cancelled: the ledger only ever sees a FILL of +4, so position and fee reflect 4 contracts, never the intended 10.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. Only FILL +4 @100 fee_rate=0.0005 slip=0 is booked: fee=4*1*100*0.0005=0.2; wallet=999.8; entry=100; mark=100; u=0; equity=999.8. The cancelled remainder (10-4=6) never fills and has no event, so no cash and no fee. MARK 102: u=4*1*(102-100)=8; equity=999.8+8=1007.8. Final: wallet 999.8, unrealized 8, equity 1007.8, realized 0, fees 0.2, funding 0, position +4. Booking the intended 10 would give position 10, fee 0.5, u 20, equity 1019.5; expected numbers pin the partial fill.
